changelog: LG webOS compatibility release. Traditional channels on LG now remain in the native Virtual TV Live TV transport and use a rebased source timeline so the current wall-clock point is exposed to the player as 00:00, avoiding the mid-file VOD start that could produce black or frozen video while audio/subtitles continued. Natural programme completion retunes the same channel so the next programme opens on a fresh rebased timeline. Channel descriptions remain stored in plugin settings but are no longer published as Jellyfin channel Overview because stock clients place that text below the full Guide instead of beneath the title.
